data.one_liner: A testing utility library for StateNotifier and Riverpod
data.what_it_does: Provides the stateNotifierTest function to easily test StateNotifier state emissions, actions, seeding, and verification, ported from bloc_test.
use_when: You are using state_notifier, riverpod, or flutter_riverpod in your project
You want a structured, readable syntax for testing state changes in StateNotifiers
avoid_when: You are not using StateNotifier or Riverpod for state management
You prefer standard Flutter test assertions without helper wrappers
strengths: Clear, declarative syntax for testing emitted states
Supports seeding initial states, skipping emissions, and custom verifications
weaknesses: Relies on a third-party port of bloc_test which may lag behind official bloc_test updates
data.setup_notes: Add state_notifier_test to dev_dependencies in pubspec.yaml.
data.minimal_example:
stateNotifierTest(
  'CounterNotifier emits [9,10] when seeded with 9',
  build: () => CounterNotifier(),
  seed: () => [9],
  actions: (stateNotifier) => stateNotifier.increment(),
  expect: () => [9,10],
);
